# Trust but Verify: Execution-Grounded Verification of LLM-Generated Software Repairs

CIS 695 research pipeline for deciding when to believe a coding agent's claim that its patch fixes an issue. An oracle-blind verifier runs each patch (integrity checks, regression tests, static checks and issue-derived reproduction tests) and decides ACCEPT, FLAG or REJECT, and the study measures on SWE-bench Verified how much more reliable an ACCEPT is than the agent's own word.

## Results

<!-- results:start -->
*Generated by `scripts/build_report_v1_5.py` from `reports/study_v1_5/results/`; do not edit by hand.*

Headline (test set, batches 1 and 2, v1.5 frozen):

| | n | base rate | ACCEPT precision [95% CI] | coverage | false-accept rate |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| gpt-4.1-mini | 98 | 22.4% [15.3%, 31.7%] | 72.2% [49.1%, 87.5%] | 59.1% [38.7%, 76.7%] | 6.6% [2.8%, 14.5%] |
| Claude Sonnet 4 | 102 | 67.6% [58.1%, 75.9%] | 88.0% [70.0%, 95.8%] | 31.9% [22.1%, 43.6%] | 9.1% [3.1%, 23.6%] |
| Gemini 2.5 Flash | 65 | 35.4% [24.9%, 47.5%] | 93.3% [70.2%, 98.8%] | 60.9% [40.8%, 77.8%] | 2.4% [0.4%, 12.3%] |
| **pooled** | 265 | 43.0% [37.2%, 49.0%] | 84.5% [73.1%, 91.6%] | 43.0% [34.3%, 52.2%] | 6.0% [3.2%, 10.9%] |

1. **An ACCEPT is worth believing.** Pooled ACCEPT precision is 84.5% [73.1%, 91.6%] against a base rate of 43.0% [37.2%, 49.0%]; the task-clustered bootstrap supports H1 and H2, and batch 2 alone replicates it (93.1% [78.0%, 98.1%] against 45.8% [37.0%, 54.7%]).
2. **V2 and V4 carry the verifier.** Forcing V4 or V2 to PASS raises the false-accept rate from 6.0% to 19.2% and 17.9%; V3 adds nothing measurable, and V1 costs the most coverage.
3. **The gold ceiling.** The verifier ACCEPTs 69/108 = 63.9% [54.5%, 72.3%] of gold patches. 11.1% of all gold patches are held back for reasons oracle-blind verification cannot fix; 25.0% by fixable verifier weaknesses.

Full report: [reports/study_v1_5/REPORT.md](reports/study_v1_5/REPORT.md).

## Repository map

| Path | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `src/reliability/` | the pipeline: benchmark loading, repair harness, verifier (V1–V4, decision policies), oracle wrapper |
| `scripts/` | command-line entry points, including `decide_v1_5.py`, `analyze_v1_5.py`, `ablate_v1_5.py` and `build_report_v1_5.py` |
| `configs/` | frozen verifier, generator, agent and study configuration |
| `tests/` | unit and end-to-end tests |
| `reports/study_v1_5/` | the v1.5 study: plan, protocol, freezes, run reports, results and the final report |
| `reports/` (other folders) | earlier work, before v1.5 |
| `docs/` | design documents and the earlier main study's results |
| `runs/` | sealed runs, labels and ledgers (not in git) |

## Setup

Linux or WSL (Docker is needed to run the verifier; the analysis and report scripts need only `python 3.11`):

```bash
uv sync
source .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME="$PWD/runs/hf_home" HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/unit
```

Windows (PowerShell; the verifier itself needs Docker Desktop with the WSL backend):

```powershell
uv sync
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
$env:PYTHONPATH = "src"
python -m pytest -q tests/unit
```
